meta.title: Signs of Winter — Vocabulary Set 2
meta.subject: English Vocabulary
meta.description: Vocabulary practice focusing on Part 1 words: daylight, bare, thick, fur, extra, season, weather, snowman.

questions.question: What is the soft hair that keeps animals warm called?
questions.explanation: Fur is the soft, thick hair that covers animals and keeps them warm in cold temperatures.

questions.question: If branches don't have any leaves, the trees are 'bare.'
questions.explanation: True. 'Bare' means empty or uncovered, describing trees that have lost their leaves in winter.

questions.question: In winter, there is very little _______ because the sun sets early.
questions.explanation: Daylight is the natural light from the sun. Days are shorter in winter, so daylight is limited.

questions.question: Winter is the hottest season of the year.
questions.explanation: False. Winter is the coldest season of the year, while summer is the hottest.

questions.question: What figure do kids build using packed snowballs in winter?
questions.explanation: A snowman is a figure made out of packed snow, which children like to build in winter.

questions.question: Bisons grow a coat that is extra long and _______ to stay warm.
questions.hint: Having a lot of heavy hair or layers.
questions.explanation: A thick coat has heavy, dense fur, which helps protect animals from freezing temperatures.

questions.question: Which word is a synonym for 'climate' or 'outside conditions'?
questions.explanation: Weather describes outside conditions like rain, wind, heat, or snow.

questions.question: Sort these Part 1 words into Nouns (naming words) or Adjectives (describing words):
questions.explanation: 'Daylight,' 'fur,' and 'snowman' are nouns. 'Thick' and 'bare' describe the qualities of things (adjectives).

questions.question: If beavers collect 'extra' logs, it means they collect more than what is normal or needed.
questions.explanation: True. 'Extra' means additional or more than the usual amount.

questions.question: Arrange the words to describe the outside conditions in winter:
questions.explanation: Correct sentence: 'The weather is very cold.' This is a typical winter description.

questions.question: Why does a bison need a 'thick' coat in winter?
options: Because it wants to swim in the pool
Because it wants to find green leaves
questions.explanation: Bisons grow a thick coat to protect their bodies when the winter temperature is cold.

questions.question: In autumn, animals collect _______ food to store for winter weeks.
questions.explanation: Animals gather extra (additional) food to survive when food is hard to find in winter.

questions.question: Arrange the words to show what Vanessa and Tom make:
questions.explanation: Correct sentence: 'We make a big snowman.' Capitalize 'We.'

questions.question: The words 'weather' and 'season' mean the exact same thing.
questions.explanation: False. A season is a three-month division of the year, while weather is the daily outside condition (rain, sun).

questions.question: If a forest has 'bare' branches, what is missing from the trees?
questions.explanation: Bare branches in winter mean the deciduous trees have dropped all their leaves.
